h: Friends of the late Francis Duru share memories of his final days
p: Tributes continue for Nollywood veteran Francis Duru, who died at 57 after a brief illness, with close friends including Empress Njamah saying they had planned to visit him before he passed. Colleagues such as Mercy Johnson Okojie have also paid tribute, and the family has asked for privacy.
more: The family confirmed his death without naming the illness.
The Actors Guild and fans have joined in mourning him.
A friend who visited him in hospital has also spoken about their last conversations.
